اصطلقتا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَلَقَتَا (iṣṭalaqatā) /isˤ.tˤa.la.qa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
# اُصْطُلِقَتَا (uṣṭuliqatā) /usˤ.tˤu.li.qa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِصْطَلَقَ (iṣṭalaqa)
